app.name: Clueberry
app.subtitle: Daily and themed crosswords in English, French, and Arabic — written by people, decorated by you.

landing.todayIntro: One featured puzzle per language, every day.
landing.editorialNote: Every official puzzle is written and edited by a person: original clues, fair crossings, and a mix of styles. The facts you see after solving come from the puzzle's own notes.
landing.guestNote: Playing as a guest — everything is saved in this browser.

game.pausedNote: The grid is hidden while paused.
game.revealPuzzleConfirm: Reveal the whole puzzle? This ends the solve.
game.shortcuts: Arrows move · Tab next clue · Shift+Tab previous · Space toggles direction · Backspace clears

game.lamAlefUnavailable: No room for lam-alef here: it needs two empty squares.
game.spaceUnavailable: Answers are a single word, so no space is needed.

settings.arabicNote: How Arabic answers are matched. Per-puzzle settings may override these.
settings.foldAlef: Treat أ إ آ as ا

auth.mergeNote: When you sign in, locally saved progress is merged into your account.

editor.intro: Internal tools for building and reviewing puzzles.

checklistItems.sensitivity: No offensive or culturally careless content

editor.author: Author

trilingual-topic.title: Trilingual

errors.puzzleNotFound: This puzzle could not be found.

footer.about: Clueberry is a small crossword publication. Official puzzles are written and reviewed by people.

journal.title: Puzzle journal
journal.intro: Your months, your stickers, your streak.
journal.empty: Nothing pasted in yet. Finish a puzzle and it lands on this page.
journal.noStickers: No stickers yet — the first one is one puzzle away.
journal.thisIsLocal: This journal lives in your browser.
journal.thisIsSynced: This journal is saved to your account and follows you between devices.

playground.title: Playground
playground.intro: Puzzles assembled on the spot from a theme you pick. No editor has read these — that's what the daily and the collections are for.
playground.failed: Not enough crossing words in that theme yet. Try another one.
playground.officialNote: Official puzzles are hand-written and reviewed. Playground puzzles are assembled for practice and are not saved to your journal.
playground.howItWorks: Type what you want and the Playground reads it here on your device — a fixed list of words and phrases, not a language model. Anything it cannot place is listed back to you.
playground.requestPlaceholder: Make me an easy geology puzzle about volcanoes
playground.requestHelp: Subject, collection, difficulty, grid size, a rough time, and a puzzle language all work. So does "another one like the last".
playground.understoodNothing: Nothing in that request matched a subject or an option.
playground.bankMissing: {topic} only has a word bank in another language so far, not {language}.
playground.needTopic: Pick a subject and collection below, or name one the Playground knows.
playground.subject: Subject
playground.timeNote: This grid size usually takes about {minutes} minutes.
playground.notesHelp: Paste a page of notes. Each clue becomes a sentence from your own text with one word blanked out.
playground.notesPlaceholder: Paste a few paragraphs of revision notes…
playground.notesLimits: Needs roughly 30 words or more, and at least a dozen words long enough to cross. Names, numbers and very short words are skipped.

failedReasons.notEnoughWords: There were not enough usable words left for that request. Try a smaller grid, another collection, or allow proper nouns.
failedReasons.noInterlock: Those words never interlocked into a grid this size. Try a smaller grid.
failedReasons.validation: Every attempt failed the crossword checks. Try another seed or a smaller grid.
failedReasons.textTooShort: That text is too short to build a puzzle from. Paste a few more sentences.

studio.intro: Your workbench. Build a crossword from a curated word bank or from your own notes, edit every clue, then keep it or share it.
studio.assistedNote: Answer a few questions and the builder assembles a grid from a curated word bank.
studio.importNotesNote: Paste revision notes and get fill-in-the-blank clues from your own text.
studio.fromScratchNote: The full constructor desk: draw the grid and write every clue yourself.
studio.draftUnbuilt: A set of choices, not built yet.
studio.signedOutNote: Building needs no account. Saving and sharing do.
studio.unreadable: This saved puzzle can no longer be read.

create.title: Make a crossword
create.intro: One step at a time, and every step can be changed later. Nothing is built until you ask for it.
create.notesSubject: Notes-based puzzles take their subject from your text, so there is nothing to pick here.
create.assistantNote: This fills in the form below so you can see and correct what was understood. It is a fixed list of phrases read on your device, not a language model.
create.generateNote: The builder runs here in your browser. Each stage below is a real pass of the generator, reported as it happens.
create.difficultyAdjusted: You asked for {requested}; the words available make this one {actual}.
create.buildFirst: Build a puzzle first — these steps work on a finished grid.
create.draftRestored: Picked up where you left off. Your last draft is on this device.

checks.unknown: A check the builder could not name.
checks.not_enough_words: Too few usable words for a grid this size.
checks.below_entry_floor: That layout held too few entries.
checks.too_many_abbreviations: Too many abbreviations in one grid.
checks.too_much_obscure_fill: Too many obscure words in one grid.
checks.too_few_crossings: Too few letters were checked by a second entry.
checks.bad_arabic_answer: An answer did not survive Arabic normalisation.
checks.numbering_failed: The grid could not be numbered.
checks.answer_key_mismatch: The answer key did not solve its own grid.
checks.duplicate_clue: Two entries had the same clue.
checks.answer_in_clue: A clue gave its own answer away.
checks.grid_conflict: Two answers disagreed on a shared letter.
checks.grid_mismatch: The grid disagreed with the answers.
checks.two_letter_answer: A two-letter answer is not allowed.
checks.not_connected: Part of the grid was cut off from the rest.

presets.title: Start from a template
presets.note: Each template only appears when its word bank exists in that language.

topic.customHelp: Matched against the collections the builder has words for. It will never invent a topic it has no words for.
topic.unknown: No word bank matches that yet. Pick a collection above, or paste your own notes instead.
topic.otherLanguage: There is a bank for that, but only in: {languages}.

themeEntries.label: Theme entries
themeEntries.help: How many of the longest answers are marked as carrying the theme.

preview.caption: {width}×{height}, {count} entries. Letters are hidden — this is the shape a solver sees.

errors.no_such_entry: That entry is no longer in the grid.
errors.wrong_length: That answer is a different length from the slot.
errors.crossing_conflict: That answer disagrees with a letter a crossing already fixes.
errors.no_other_clue: The word bank has no other clue for this answer.
errors.validation_failed: That change would break the puzzle.

save.signInNote: Your puzzle is finished and playable right now. Signing in is what lets you keep it, edit it later, and share a link. You can also download it as a file first.
save.shareNote: A shared puzzle is always labelled a Playground puzzle and never appears among the reviewed ones.
save.notShared: Not shared. Nobody else can open it.
save.draftNote: Unsaved work stays on this device until you clear it.

errors.save_failed: That did not save. Try again.
errors.cap_reached: You have reached the limit of saved Playground puzzles. Delete one to make room.
errors.invalid_definition: That puzzle could not be read.
errors.validation_failed: The server refused the change: the puzzle would not be solvable.

shared.label: Shared Playground puzzle
shared.note: Made by a player with the Playground builder. No editor has reviewed it, and solving it is not recorded in your journal.

account.signInLead: Welcome back. Your puzzles are where you left them.
account.registerLead: An account keeps your progress, stickers and streak across devices. You never need one to play.
account.registerDoneBody: Welcome to Clueberry. Your desk is set up.

account.displayNameHint: The name on your desk. Up to 40 characters.
account.usernameHint: 3 to 20 characters: lowercase letters, digits, hyphen or underscore, starting with a letter or digit.
account.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, using at least 5 different ones.
account.guestEscapeNote: You never need an account to try a puzzle.
account.mergeNote: When you sign in, progress saved in this browser is merged into your account.
account.migrateNote: {count, plural, one {One puzzle} other {# puzzles}} saved in this browser will be copied into your account.

account.migrateFailed: Your account is fine, but the puzzles saved in this browser could not be copied. They are still here — try again from your desk.
account.resetRequestLead: Enter the address you signed up with.
account.resetNewLead: This link works once, and only for an hour.
account.resetDoneBody: Your password has been changed and every session was signed out. Sign in with the new one.
account.resetNoMailTitle: Email delivery is not configured in this build

account.resetNoLink: No message was sent, and the server produced no link for that address.
account.resetSentTitle: The email is on its way
account.resetSentBody: If that address has an account, a reset link has been sent. It expires in one hour.
account.verifyExpired: This link has expired. Ask for a new one from your desk.
account.verifyUsed: This link has already been used.
account.verifyNoToken: This page needs a confirmation link. Open the one you were given.
account.verifyNoMailTitle: Email delivery is not configured in this build
account.verifyNoMailBody: No confirmation email was sent. This is the confirmation link the server produced; it lasts 48 hours.
account.verifyNoLink: No confirmation email was sent, and the server produced no link.
account.verifySentTitle: A confirmation email is on its way
account.verifySentBody: Open the link in it to confirm your address.
account.multiplayerNameHint: The name other players see in a room. Leave it empty to use your display name.
account.showPresenceHint: Turn this off and other players will not see you in rooms.

errors.email_invalid: That does not look like an email address.

rooms.notConfiguredBody: This deployment has no room server, so there is nowhere for a shared grid to live. Nothing is broken — solving on your own works exactly as it should.
rooms.notConfiguredHint: Rooms need a long-running WebSocket process, which a serverless host cannot keep open. Whoever runs this site can point NEXT_PUBLIC_REALTIME_URL at one to switch rooms on.
